note: Packages the setup the Edge team runs on a shared, always-on Mac mini and the flows that use it: two-user layout with auto-login, Tailscale node sharing, a Claude Code tmux session started from Terminal and kept alive by a LaunchAgent, logged-in Chrome profiles as LaunchAgents driven over CDP, form filling through an isolated tab, and demo recording through the published record-mac-demo skill. Generalised from the team's private operating notes and scripts for that machine; every hostname, address, account name, key path, password location and personal detail was removed and replaced by placeholders (agent-box, owner, helper). scripts/cdp_tab.py is a generalised copy of the team's private CDP tab driver and persistence test. No EVALS.md ships yet, so no benefit over an agent without the Skill is claimed.
